name: dynamic interaction
domain: 列车轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 系统不同组成部分在动态作用下彼此影响的过程。

complete_examples.text: The fatigue damage and residual deformation of the concrete structure under the action of the previous train were taken as one of the initial conditions of the dynamic equation of the next train-track-substructure dynamic interaction, and the coupled time-varying analysis of the spatial vibration and fatigue damage evolution for this unified system was realized.
The three sub-systems were coupled into a dynamic unified matrix equation, and a unified analysis model for the railway train-track-substructure dynamic interaction was established subsequently.
